info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Settlement Accounts API
info.description: The Manage Settlement Accounts API allows businesses to update details of existing settlement accounts efficiently. This endpoint supports the modification of specified account attributes, catering to the dynamic requirements of payment processing. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and payment service providers that need to keep their account information up-to-date. By providing a streamlined approach to managing accounts, this API enhances operational agility and ensures compliance with evolving financial regulations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific settlement account identified by its unique account number. Make sure to provide the necessary fields that need to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the settlement account details. This body allows you to provide the necessary information required for modifying the existing account, such as updates to attributes or settings.
